page_title: NME Drug and New Biologic Approvals in 2006
row_count_note: Page prints two tables: 18 NDA approvals and 4 BLA approvals (22 total novel rows; matches FDA's official 2006 novel count of 22).

rows.indication: Provides for the treatment of gastrointestinal stromal tumor after disease progression on or intolerance to imatinib mesylate.
Provides for the treatment of chronic angina. Because Ranexa prolongs the QT interval, it should be reserved for patients who have not achieved an adequate response with other antianginal drugs.
Provides for the treatment of chronic idiopathic constipation in the adult population.
Provides for the treatment of patients with esophageal candidiasis. [Vicuron Pharmaceuticals was acquired by Pfizer in 2005; applicant entity is Pfizer's Vicuron subsidiary.]
Provides for the treatment of myelodysplastic syndrome (MDS).
Provides for use as an aid to smoking cessation.
Provides for the treatment of the signs and symptoms of idiopathic Parkinson's disease as initial monotherapy and as adjunct therapy to levodopa.

When coadministered with 100 mg of ritonavir, provides for the treatment of human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) infection in antiretroviral treatment-experienced adult patients, such as those with HIV-1 strains resistant to more than one protease inhibitor. [Tibotec = J&J subsidiary (Tibotec Therapeutics, Janssen).]
Provides for the treatment of adults with chronic myeloid leukemia with resistance or intolerance to prior therapy including imatinib.
Provides for the prevention of sunburn and to help provide protection from UVA and UVB rays.

Provides for the treatment of prophylaxis of invasive Aspergillus and Candida infections in patients, 13 years of age and older, who are at high risk of developing these infections due to being severely immunocompromised, such as hematopoietic stem cell transplant (HSCT) recipients with Graft versus Host Disease (GVHD) or those with hematologic malignancies with prolonged neutropenia from chemotherapy.
Provides for the treatment of patients with Helicobacter pylori infection and duodenal ulcer disease (active or history of within the past 5 years) to eradicate H. pylori.
Provides for the treatment of cutaneous manifestations in patients with cutaneous T-cell lymphoma (CTCL) who have progressive, persistent or recurrent disease on or following two systemic therapies.

Provides for the use as an adjunct to diet and exercise to improve gylcemic control in patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus as monotherapy and in combination with metformin or a PPARγ agonist (e.g., thiazolidinediones) when diet and excercise plus the single agent do not provide adequate glycemic control. [FDA table prints 'gylcemic' and 'excercise'; verbatim.]
Provides for the treatment of seasonal and allergic rhinitis in patients 12 years of age and older. [Altana Pharma US; Altana's pharma business became Nycomed 2007; Nycomed acquired by Takeda 2011.]
Provides for the treatment of chronic hepatitis B (CHB) in patients with evidence of viral replication and active liver inflammation. [Co-developed with Novartis.]
Provides for the topical treatment of external genital and perianal warts (Condylomata acuminata) in immunocompetent patients 18 years and older.
Provides for the treatment of schizophrenia.
Provides for the treatment of Pompe disease (GAA deficiency).
Provides for the treatment of patients with neovascular (wet) age-related macular degeneration.
Provides for the treatment of patients with Hunter syndrome (Mucopolysaccharidosis II, MPS II).
Provides for the treatment of EGFR-expressing metastatic colorectal carcinoma with disease progression on or following fluoropyrimidine, oxaliplatin, and irinotecan containing chemotherapy regimens.
